description: This file defines the ExcelMatch class which implements the MATCH function used in spreadsheet calculations. It includes methods for different match types, validation, and handling of lookup arrays.

classes.name: ExcelMatch
classes.description: Class implementing the MATCH function for spreadsheet calculations, supporting different match types and array handling.

methods.name: MATCH
methods.description: Performs a lookup to find the position of a value in an array based on match type.

methods.name: matchFirstValue
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a value in an array, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: matchLargestValue
methods.description: Finds the largest value less than or equal to the lookup value, considering case sensitivity and wildcards.

methods.name: matchSmallestValue
methods.description: Finds the smallest value greater than or equal to the lookup value, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: validateLookupValue
methods.description: Validates that the lookup value is of a permissible type.

methods.name: validateMatchType
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the match type parameter.

methods.name: validateLookupArray
methods.description: Ensures the lookup array is not empty.

methods.name: prepareLookupArray
methods.description: Prepares the lookup array by filtering and converting string cases based on match type.
